name: Password (Context-Anchored)
summary: Detects passwords by keyword context in prose (e.g., 'password: Tr!cky$and2025')
description: Detects passwords by keyword proximity in prose and label-value text. Matches values following password-related labels with either a colon/equals separator (config-style: 'password: VALUE', 'pwd=VALUE') or plain whitespace (prose-style: 'the password VALUE in plaintext'). Enforces a 4-character minimum. Uses reject_keywords to suppress false positives on instructional text ('password reset link', 'password policy', etc.). For JSON-structured passwords see credentials.password_context_json.

effect.message: Password redacted — detected by keyword context
